critical_code_review_comments: TestimonialsSection/TestimonialCarousel key collision for the two Donna Kargel testimonials generates repeated React warnings on every mount (home, /recruit, /reactivate, /activate, /recruit/checkout). Recommend keying by array index or by (name + organization) instead of name only.

Module 6 non-agreement tools ('Board Member Onboarding Script', 'Onboarding Agenda', 'Organization Overview', 'Board Manual', '90-Day Plan') and agreements are all per-applicant and gated behind 'Only applicants whose status is Selected appear here'. In Owner Review Mode with no applicants marked Selected, the tools are not visible on the page — this appears to be intended design, but if the review-mode walkthrough is expected to show these tools without an applicant, main agent may want to expose a demo/preview state.
review_routes.board_profile_submit stores every field as str() including list-like inputs (skills/committees). Fine for MVP; consider list handling if the public form later posts arrays.
